trap.label: attribute to
trap.wrong: Executives attribute success at a strong team.
trap.right: Executives attribute success to a strong team.
trap.why: O brasileiro troca a preposição por “a/em/por”. Em inglês, attribute A to B.

mcq.q: Executives attribute success ___ a strong team.

opts: The loss was attributed to errors.
The loss was attributed by errors.

fix.wrong: They attributed the loss on errors.
fix.right: They attributed the loss to errors.

rewrite.answer: Analysts attribute the fall to costs.

rewrite.prompt: Passado passiva: “They attribute the loss to errors.”
rewrite.answer: The loss was attributed to errors.
